labels.label: states_rule
labels.description: The paragraph states a legal rule, test, principle, or requirement.

labels.label: applies_rule
labels.description: The paragraph applies a rule to facts.

labels.label: distinguishes_rule
labels.description: The paragraph distinguishes an authority, rule, or fact pattern.

labels.label: limits_rule
labels.description: The paragraph limits or qualifies a rule.

labels.label: sets_out_test
labels.description: The paragraph sets out a multi-part legal test or threshold.

labels.label: illustrates_fact_pattern
labels.description: The paragraph is mainly useful as a fact-pattern illustration.

labels.label: explains_procedure
labels.description: The paragraph explains procedure, sequencing, or procedural consequences.

labels.label: not_authority_party_argument
labels.description: The paragraph records a party argument or submission and must not be treated as the court's holding.

labels.label: procedural_history_only
labels.description: The paragraph is procedural background only.

labels.label: irrelevant
labels.description: The paragraph is not relevant to the criminal/evidence tree.
